    function createTaperedTube(curve, tubularSegments, radialSegments, startRadius, endRadius) {
      const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(tubularSegments, false);
      const vertices = [];
      const uvs = [];
      const indices = [];

      for (let i = 0; i <= tubularSegments; i++) {
        const t = i / tubularSegments;
        const center = curve.getPointAt(t);
        const radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(startRadius, endRadius, t);
        const normal = frames.normals[i];
        const binormal = frames.binormals[i];

        for (let j = 0; j <= radialSegments; j++) {

          const sin = Math.sin(angle);

          const y = center.y + normal.y * cos * radius + binormal.y * sin * radius;
          const z = center.z + normal.z * cos * radius + binormal.z * sin * radius;

          uvs.push(j / radialSegments, t);

        for (let j = 0; j < radialSegments; j++) {

          const b = a + radialSegments + 1;
          const c = b + 1;

      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

      renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
      renderer.setSize(width, height);

      if (!hasUserZoomed) {
        const halfWidth = 8.6;
        const fitRadius =
          (halfWidth / Math.tan(THREE.MathUtils.degToRad(camera.fov * 0.5))) *
          Math.max(1, 0.85 / aspect);

        desired.radius = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(fitRadius, 12, 46);
      }
    }

    window.addEventListener("resize", onResize);
    onResize();

    // Animation
    const clock = new THREE.Clock();

    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
      const delta = Math.min(clock.getDelta(), 0.05);
      const damping = 1 - Math.exp(-8 * delta);

      current.radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(current.radius, desired.radius, damping);
      current.theta = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(current.theta, desired.theta, damping);
      current.phi = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(current.phi, desired.phi, damping);

      updateCamera();
      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();
  </script>
